title: How to Improve Your Salon Rebooking Rate: 8 Ways That Work

facts.fact: The chunk gives an illustrative calculation in which 180 of 400 clients rebooked, producing a rebooking rate of 45%.
facts.quote: For example, if 180 out of 400 clients rebooked, your rate is 45%.

facts.fact: The rebooking rate formula is the number of clients who rebooked before leaving divided by total clients served, multiplied by 100.
facts.quote: Rebooking rate = (number of clients who rebooked before leaving ÷ total clients served) × 100

facts.fact: Published industry benchmarks put the average salon rebooking rate between 40% and 55%; the page does not name the source.
facts.quote: Published industry benchmarks put the average somewhere between 40% and 55%

facts.fact: Many owners work towards a 60% rebooking rate, and the strongest salons pass 70%, according to the page.
facts.quote: plenty of owners work towards 60%, and the strongest salons pass 70%.

facts.fact: Recommended appointment interval for gel or acrylic nails is every 2 to 3 weeks.
facts.quote: Gel or acrylic nails: every 2 to 3 weeks

facts.fact: Recommended appointment interval for fades and short men's cuts is every 3 to 4 weeks.
facts.quote: Fades and short men’s cuts: every 3 to 4 weeks

facts.fact: Recommended appointment interval for root colour is every 4 to 6 weeks.
facts.quote: Root colour: every 4 to 6 weeks

facts.fact: Recommended appointment interval for facials is about once a month.
facts.quote: Facials: about once a month

facts.fact: The page recommends sending a single appointment reminder a couple of days before the appointment.
facts.quote: at least a single one a couple of days before

facts.fact: The page recommends contacting a client who has not rebooked a few days before their appointment slot.
facts.quote: contact them a few days before their appointment slot

facts.fact: For inactive clients, the page recommends a friendly check-in once someone is overdue, then one more message a couple of weeks later.
facts.quote: Send a friendly check-in once someone is overdue, then one more message a couple of weeks later

facts.fact: The page recommends checking the rebooking rate monthly alongside the 90-day return rate.
facts.quote: Check your rebooking rate monthly alongside your 90-day return rate.

facts.fact: The page says that counting bookings made a day or two after the visit is acceptable, provided the salon uses one consistent rule.
facts.quote: Some salons also count bookings made a day or two later. That’s fine, just stick to one rule.

facts.fact: The page states that most salons have a rebooking rate between 40% and 55%.
facts.quote: Most salons land between 40% and 55%. Many owners aim for 60%.

facts.fact: The page says many salon owners aim for a rebooking rate of 60%.
facts.quote: Many owners aim for 60%. The strongest salons pass 70%.

facts.fact: The page says the strongest salons pass a rebooking rate of 70%.
facts.quote: The strongest salons pass 70%.

facts.fact: The page gives an example calculation: if 180 of 400 clients rebooked, the salon rebooking rate is 45%.
facts.quote: If 180 out of 400 clients rebooked your rate is 45%.

facts.fact: The page defines salon rebooking rate as clients who rebooked before leaving divided by total clients served, multiplied by 100.
facts.quote: Divide the clients who rebooked before leaving by the total clients served. Then multiply by 100.

facts.fact: The page says gel or acrylic nail clients need a visit every 2 to 3 weeks.
facts.quote: Gel or acrylic nails need a visit every 2 to 3 weeks.

facts.fact: The page says fades and short men's cuts need a visit every 3 to 4 weeks.
facts.quote: Fades and short men’s cuts need one every 3 to 4 weeks.

facts.fact: The page says root colour needs a visit every 4 to 6 weeks.
facts.quote: Root colour needs a visit every 4 to 6 weeks.

facts.fact: The page says facials work best about once a month.
facts.quote: Facials work best about once a month.

facts.fact: The page states that a few percentage points per quarter is a sensible rebooking rate improvement goal.
facts.quote: A few points a quarter is a sensible goal.

facts.fact: The page advises changing one thing at a time and giving each change a full month.
facts.quote: Try to make just one change, perhaps the reminder time, and give it a full month.
